native_endpoint_diagnostic.scope: Same original actor parameters, official full uncached forward and original DT runner; synthetic EOS-only responses on recorded owner prompts. No reward, task-success or new tolerance test.
native_endpoint_diagnostic.finding: Identical token endpoints have exactly zero DT credit. Nonzero endpoint score differences also occur in the original uncached full forward, before DT finite propagation. In the all-equal fixture first uncached hidden difference is at layer2 (0.0009765625), cached root at layer0. This does not establish a new DT-only defect or an operator tolerance pass.
native_endpoint_diagnostic.acceptance: Keep original FA/FLA operator criteria and existing end-to-end diagnostics; the existing0.02 conservation observation is not a new production gate and no credit renormalization was added.

operand_replay.scope:
Replay saved native operands with original PyTorch/FLA operations.

This is a numerical diagnostic, not a training implementation or a whole-model
acceptance test. It does not load the full model or change the training runtime.

fla_forward.scope: Saved native FLA output on its actual operands, forward only.

native_endpoint_diagnostic.interpretation: Recorded BF16 linear is exactly reproduced by the original PyTorch operator on saved layer2 input and checkpoint weight. One pair straddles a BF16 rounding midpoint; FP32 pair outputs coincide. Actual native FLA forward passes the original owner assertion. This is not a whole-model or finite-attribution acceptance and does not change training precision or any formula.

model_generation_settings.finding: Qwen publishes task/mode-dependent sampling and presence penalties. The fixed training/readout policy uses temperature1 and untruncated token probabilities. Greedy comparisons only isolate owner behavior. Do not insert the model-card penalties into rollout alone and claim an unchanged policy/QV interface.
model_generation_settings.change: No training prompt, parser, reward, policy sampling or response-cap change made.

native_profiler.scope: Profiled original vLLM16 engine steps; profiler affects absolute time. Kernel/memcpy union within GPU annotations excludes idle gaps; do not equate this profile latency with unprofiled generation throughput.

bounded_native_vllm_profile.interpretation: Native graph execution reduces launch gaps. Existing prefix-cache path produces a reproducible incorrect cache-hit first token even in eager/greedy mode; explicit align does not fix it. Original prefix-cache toggle off removes that observed defect; hot128-token16-request RPCs13.368s eager/GPU5 and5.035s graphs/GPU4. Final config32k and continuous task checks remain; formal training stopped.
